ac:layout-cell.h1: Customer Onboarding Sequence and Reuse Assessment
ac:layout-cell.p: Stakeholder summary — SEI018 · Business behaviour — SEI019 · Predecessor — SEI020

This separate successor to SPEC-SEI-020 provides the main sequence-led engineering view. Three core sequences and two change/recovery sequences replace eight repeated flows. Scenario, gap and acceptance IDs keep their meanings. Business scope, source contracts and open implementation decisions remain unchanged. SPEC020 is retained in the archive for detailed assurance and source analysis. This draft uses the same engineering topic, not another Confluence page; the stable onboarding page still selects SPEC-SEI-002.

Help a Spanish business or authorised accountant confirm or establish selected e-invoicing functions through Sage. Engineers need to identify reusable calls, Spain changes and missing evidence. Reuse the FR APIs and bind country/provider rules separately. New endpoints and payload design are outside scope. REF-REUSE; REF-COUNTRY.
Phase 1 is public readiness. Private setup and activation require later-phase qualification. Private A to Private B remains disabled. SEI019 owns the business requirements. REF-LOGICAL.
Use the API and capability table for the inventory and reuse gaps; section 4 assigns owners and evidence.

Product integration impact: no breaking API change has been established. The rows below identify possible platform changes and product work to assess. Exact Spain inputs, prerequisite/result contracts and event coverage remain unconfirmed; an existing FR integration does not establish Spain readiness. GAP-02/05/07/08.

tr.th: Impact on products using existing APIs

tr.td: Public platform MVP
Bind Spain service/environment, NIF/authority and Tax certificate readiness; qualify public checks and per-function results. Internal dataset/connection need remains open.

Reuse valid business evidence. Handle invalid NIF, missing authority, unsuitable certificates, unconfirmed checks and owned actions. Additional prerequisite/result integration may be needed; exact contracts are open.
API-01/02/04; shared and public sequences. REF-TRUST; SPFE-S02/S03/S08; GAP-02/03/05/06.
Public platform nice-to-haves
Additional renewal/remediation reminders and richer progress guidance; qualify supporting notifications.
Optional notification/UI work. Core observation and owned recovery remain MVP requirements.
Existing event/read patterns are candidates; Spain public event support is unverified. INT-AP01/06; GAP-05/06.
Private platforms
Bind each provider's account, Spain addresses/usage, credentials and receiving evidence. Qualify API/UI eligibility and route effects before connect.
Assess provider-specific inputs and setup UI. Reuse existing connections; handle partial address results and separate sending/receiving readiness. Gate handover and preserve earlier-invoice access.
API-01–05; private and change sequences. INT-AP01–06; GAP-02/04/05/06/07.
Other shared changes
Qualify dataset/business/client mapping, Spain provisioning inputs, key/replay semantics, event versions and compatibility. Approval/portfolio implementation coverage remains unknown.

Retain dataset/connection IDs. Distinguish provisioning started from completion; preserve original request identity and avoid duplicate connect during RETRYING. Native-product channel linkage needs confirmation.
Dataset provisioning; API-02–05; recovery. INT-DS01; FR-01–05; GAP-01/04/07/08.

ac:layout-cell.p: Existing labels show supplied methods, full paths and success codes; wrapped paths retain every segment. To qualify labels describe logical requests/returns with no confirmed contract. Participants group responsibilities, not approved deployment boundaries. Solid arrows are requests; dashed arrows are responses; grey bars show handling intervals without timing promises. A ref box invokes another sequence conditionally; it is not an API call.

All views assume authorised business access and the correct environment. HTTP success, setup, per-function readiness and route activation have separate meanings. Failed/unknown evidence holds dependent work and returns an owner. Terms follow the shared glossary.

Use once per selected business/purpose. Reuse current evidence; check only missing/stale evidence. Keep represented-business NIF, establishment/routing references, authenticated caller and action authority separate. Certificate lookup returns readiness and a protected reference, never key material. Unavailable lookup does not prove that another upload is needed. REF-LOGICAL ONB-02/03; REF-TRUST.

Dataset POSTs show the successful create/confirm path, conditional on the channel. Preserve identical input and X-Idempotency-Key; 202 supplies no ID. Retain confirmed tenantId as datasetId. Replay limits, differing example data.id, Spain inputs and native-product linkage remain gates. INT-DS01.
Full-size SVG · Editable Draw.io · PNG

Reuse valid public evidence; run only missing/stale checks under qualified contracts. Existing public access does not prove Sage access. The selected action's authority must be established; third-party recovery/consultation needs the registered-authority evidence in SPFE-S02 Article 11. No external enrolment or test-invoice probe is inferred. REF-LOGICAL ONB-03/04/11; SPFE-S02/S03/S08.
Full-size SVG · Editable Draw.io · PNG

Inspect known Sage setup first. For a retained provider, keep its account and add only missing Sage setup. Connect may change address routing: qualify provider effects, route authority and historical continuity before dispatch. Skip connect when setup already matches. FR-02/03/04; INT-AP01/04/05; REF-LOGICAL ONB-05–09.

Provider timing is unconfirmed; the drawn handoff does not promise synchronous completion after 201. Use qualified per-address events/detail observations, then assess sending and receiving independently. Activation needs separate evidence. INT-AP01/06.
Qualify each provider's API/UI eligibility, credentials/signing purpose, address/usage rules, environment and receiving destination. INT-AP01/06; REF-TRUST.
Full-size SVG · Editable Draw.io · PNG

Unchanged valid setup needs no mutation, new input or route version. Refresh only affected prerequisites. A requested extension uses qualified update semantics; a platform transition also needs its enabled scope, future-work boundary and earlier-invoice access confirmed before route-affecting calls. Private A to Private B stays disabled. REF-LOGICAL ONB-S05/S06, ONB-07/09; REF-ROUTING.
Full-size SVG · Editable Draw.io · PNG

Use after a possible effect, conflicting observations or an unsupported/unknown setup. Preserve the original business, provider, environment and operation identity. A failed/empty read does not prove absence. Record confirmed success once; retry proven absence only under qualified semantics and current authority. Otherwise hold dependent work with an owner. Preserve valid independent functions. REF-LOGICAL ONB-08/11, OFR-01–08.
Do not duplicate platform RETRYING work, force a provider switch or use delete/recreate recovery. INT-AP05/06.
Full-size SVG · Editable Draw.io · PNG
Documented France behaviour and demo success do not prove Spain readiness. GAP IDs link to the owners/evidence in section 4; supporting capability rows identify candidates, not confirmed APIs.

ac:layout-cell.p: SEI019 remains authoritative for ONB-S01–08. These rows select the technical path; they add no business scope.

tr.td: ONB-S01 No established setup
Shared, then the selected public/private path. Provision only required missing resources; apply phase and route gates.
ONB-S02 Existing public service
Public path; reuse valid evidence and establish missing Sage access.
ONB-S03 Private provider retained
Private path; keep its account. Existing external registration does not prove a Sage connection.
ONB-S04 Public and private together
Evaluate both paths independently; preserve partial results, enforce public-copy/reporting dependencies and retain one delivery executor.
ONB-S05 Existing Sage setup
Confirm unchanged references; use supported change only for stale checks or requested extensions.
ONB-S06 Platform change
Supported change, with private setup only where needed; retain earlier invoice context.
ONB-S07 Existing B2G
Assess B2B through the selected path; preserve B2G configuration and references.
ONB-S08 Unsupported/unknown
Return the precise limitation and owner. Use recovery only where earlier effects need observation.

ac:layout-cell.p: Existing GAP IDs retain SPEC020 meanings. Each owner must identify the actual reused build, local changes and evidence before enabling the affected function.

tr.td: GAP-01 Resource identity / all

Confirm tenantId versus data.id, dataset/business/address cardinality, multiple-NIF use, partner/client isolation and native-channel mapping. Multiple addresses do not prove multiple legal entities. INT-DS01; FR-02–05.
API, Identity, Tax, Enablement.
GAP-02 Country binding / all

Bind Spain identifiers, business-type codes, authority, address/usage rules, service/environment and provider coverage. Classify configuration, country/provider work or contract gap. REF-COUNTRY; INT-DS01; INT-AP06.
Spain Product/Compliance, API, Integration.
GAP-03 Authority / all
Prove represented-business and direct/delegated action scope independently of M2M access, certificate possession or request user. SPFE-S02; REF-TRUST.
Identity, Security, Product.
GAP-04 Mutation safety / shared, private, change, recovery
Qualify create/confirm replay, X-Idempotency-Key versus Idempotency-Key, duplicate windows, partial effects, update concurrency and original-effect observation. FR-03/05; INT-DS01.
API, Integration, Operations.
GAP-05 Result meaning / public, private, change, recovery

Qualify partial/missing addresses, status-to-function mapping, event library, evidence freshness and independent activation. A CONNECTED resource or absent address is insufficient. FR-02/04; INT-AP05/06.
API, E-Invoice Service, Routing.
GAP-06 Companion coverage / all
Prove NIF/Tax readiness, custody and selected-purpose fitness; qualify subscription/UI eligibility, approvals, case/batch and route capabilities. REF-TRUST; INT-AP01–03.
Architecture and dependency owners.
GAP-07 Source conflicts / all

Pin build/contract: RECEIVE enum, update/remove/DELETE, takeover/conflicts, dates/lengths/auth, statuses/events and header/version differences. Resolve 24-hour retry versus six-day escalation and seven-day error observations; the latter is not audit retention. INT-AP01–06.
FR API/dataset owners, Operations.
GAP-08 Implementation qualification / all
Record retained behaviour, Spain changes, actual caller impact, regressions, monitoring, recovery and support ownership. Existing capability documentation is not production readiness.
Architecture, API, Integration, Operations.
